_comment: The Quest-DB record schema, DECLARATIVE. The reader interprets exactly this subset: `required` = dotted paths that must exist and be non-empty; `types` = basic type pins; `enums` = closed vocabularies. One file per quest (q<gvar>_<slug>.json), UTF-8 on disk, ASCII keys; prompt-visible text fields (brief, stages[].next_step/say) are BYTE-MIGRATED from the atom registry — the grounded docs feed the NON-rendered fields. DRAFT records never reach prompts/routing (QDB_DRAFT_SKIP); the manifest generator may use their citation-audited mechanical half.
_required_note: `required` binds EVERY record (the identity/mechanical core a DRAFT must already carry); `required_done` additionally binds status:DONE (the world-half completeness a record needs before prompts may consume it). A DRAFT with empty maps/reward is legal — it can never reach prompts anyway (QDB_DRAFT_SKIP).
_node_roles_shape: routing.node_roles = [{script, proc, role}] — SCRIPT-QUALIFIED (Q102's make-leave nodes live in KCTORR while its pitch is the Duntons'; node999 is a dead-end in TWO scripts). The reader builds role_index[script][proc] -> (role, gvar) across ALL loaded records.
_win_vars_shape: scene.win_vars = [{tag, mvar}] — the map-GLOBAL vars (mapGetGlobalVar) the engine emits for this scene; feeds the kSceneVars manifest generator.
_deliverable_note: PRESENCE-BLINDNESS FIX (2026-07-19). OPTIONAL block: a record WITHOUT it behaves byte-for-byte as before. It declares the physical ENTITY a quest hands over (Nagor's dog, a brahmin herd, a delivered item) so the presence frame can resolve a FOUR-valued presence verdict (here|not_yet|gone|unknown) from the engine perceive roster and remove that entity from the LLM's authorship surface. It is INERT DESCRIPTIVE DATA: it declares NOTHING the exe must emit, so it deliberately feeds NEITHER manifest_rows() NOR manifest_var_rows() and CANNOT perturb expected_fingerprint(). It is validated SEPARATELY by the reader: a malformed block is stripped and logged, the RECORD still loads — a data typo must never cost a turn its quest.

deliverable_block._pid_note: THE JOIN KEY. The engine already puts the pid on the wire inside the perceive key freeWorldMemoryKey(c) = '<map>_<pid>_<id>' (or 'comp_<pid>_<id>' for a party member). NEVER join on the display name: names are localized, duplicated, and Smoke answers to BOTH «Смок» and «Дым».
deliverable_block._aliases_note: SANITIZER match-set, NOT prompt text. Must cover the real Russian inflections the memory gate will meet (Смок/Смока/Смоку/Смоком, пёс/пса/псу). The gate matches subject AND polarity — it drops only clauses asserting CURRENT presence/absence, never true history.
deliverable_block._present_when_note: gvar predicate over THIS record's gvar, e.g. '>=5'. Ops: >= <= > < == != (bare '=' reads as '=='). Below it -> verdict not_yet (honest absence). Author it from the record's own completed_threshold — never guess.
deliverable_block._strict_aliases_note: OPTIONAL. The unambiguous PROPER-NAME forms only. `aliases` may (and for Smoke must) contain ordinary common nouns («пёс», «собака», and «Дым» = the Russian word for smoke); that full set is used ONLY inside the deliverable's OWNING NPC (expected_at.npc). Everywhere else the sanitizer — a memory-DELETION match set — is restricted to strict_aliases, and with none declared it matches nothing at all outside the owner. Adversarial review 2026-07-19: the unrestricted list deleted «Хакунин ждёт Клыка» and «здесь пахнет дымом от костра» from unrelated NPCs, permanently.
deliverable_block._failed_when_note: OPTIONAL. One predicate or a list of them (same grammar as present_when) marking TERMINAL FAIL values of this gvar. A satisfied failed_when resolves the verdict to `unknown` — render nothing, assert nothing. Without it every non-complete value collapses into one negative and a KILLED deliverable is described as «дело не доведено до конца», i.e. a false engine claim that never expires.
